privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Texas Home Outlet handles information from lead forms, chat, appointments, staff sign-in, analytics, and electronic signing.
sections: Who we are

Texas Home Outlet is a manufactured and modular home retailer operated by Prosperity Acquisitions, Inc. dba Texas Home Outlet, 10685 FM 1960 East, Huffman, TX 77336. Phone: (281) 324-3020. Email: sales@texashomeoutlet.com. This policy explains what information we collect through this website and how we use it. Effective date: [EFFECTIVE DATE].
Information we collect

When you fill out a lead or contact form, chat with us, or book a showroom visit, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, messages, home preferences, and appointment details. If you work with us on a purchase, we also keep the details needed for your documents. Our website also records basic technical information such as IP address, browser type, pages visited, and the site or ad that sent you here.
How we use information

We use your information to answer questions, follow up on home inquiries, schedule and confirm showroom visits, prepare purchase documents, provide customer service, keep business records, and protect the website. When you give us your contact details, our team may call, text, or email you about your request.
AI chat assistant

Our chat assistant uses AI to answer questions and collect inquiry or appointment details. Chat messages are processed by our AI technology provider and may be reviewed by our team. AI answers can be incomplete or wrong, so please confirm pricing, availability, financing, and appointments with a staff member. Do not type Social Security numbers, bank details, passwords, or other sensitive information into chat.
Electronic documents and signatures

If you buy a home from us, we may send documents for you to review and sign online through DocuSeal, an electronic signature service. The signing service records your name, email address, signature, and signing details such as date, time, and IP address so there is a reliable record of the agreement. You will be asked to agree to electronic signing first, and you can ask for paper copies instead.
Staff sign-in

Our team members sign in to staff tools with their work email address. We send a one-time sign-in link or code to that address and keep a record of sign-ins to protect customer information. Staff sign-in is not used for customers.
Cookies, browser storage, and analytics

The website stores small pieces of information in your browser to keep your chat session, sign-in, and settings working. We may also use optional analytics and ad measurement tools, such as Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or TikTok Pixel, to see which pages and ads help shoppers. These tools only run after you choose Allow analytics, and you can change your choice at any time with the Privacy choices button. We do not send your name, email, phone number, or messages to analytics providers. Your browser settings can also block cookies and storage, but some features may stop working.
Who we share information with

We share information with companies that help us run the business, such as website hosting, email delivery, AI chat, analytics, and electronic signature providers. If you ask us to connect you with a lender, insurer, or other partner, we will share what is needed for that request. We may also share information when the law requires it or to protect people, property, or our business.
How long we keep information and how we protect it

We keep information as long as we need it to handle your inquiry, complete a sale, keep business and legal records, and resolve disputes. We use reasonable safeguards to protect information, but no website or internet transmission is completely secure.
Your choices

You do not have to fill out a form or use chat to shop with us. To ask what information we have about you, correct it, delete it, or stop hearing from us, email sales@texashomeoutlet.com, call (281) 324-3020, or write to us at the address above. We may need to confirm your identity first, and we may keep records the law requires us to keep.
Children and other websites
This website is meant for adult home shoppers. Please do not submit information about children. Links to lenders, manufacturers, and other websites follow those companies' own privacy policies.
Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will post the new version here with a new effective date. Questions? Contact Prosperity Acquisitions, Inc. dba Texas Home Outlet at sales@texashomeoutlet.com or (281) 324-3020.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for using the Texas Home Outlet website, including home listings, pricing, financing estimates, AI chat, and appointments.
sections: About these terms

These terms apply to the Texas Home Outlet website, operated by Prosperity Acquisitions, Inc. dba Texas Home Outlet, a manufactured and modular home retailer at 10685 FM 1960 East, Huffman, TX 77336. Phone: (281) 324-3020. Email: sales@texashomeoutlet.com. By using this website, you agree to these terms. Effective date: [EFFECTIVE DATE].
Home listings and prices

Listings, photos, floor plans, sizes, features, prices, and availability are for general information and can change without notice. Photos may show optional features, decor, or model homes. Before you buy, confirm the exact home, included features, total price, taxes, delivery, setup, site work, permits, and utility costs with our team. Nothing on this website is a binding offer or a sales contract.
Financing and purchase agreements

Financing information and payment estimates are examples only. They are not loan approvals or guaranteed rates or terms. Lenders decide approval and terms based on your situation. Any purchase, deposit, delivery, warranty, or financing is covered by the separate written agreements and disclosures you receive. These website terms do not replace those agreements or limit any rights you have under the law.
Electronic signatures

If you choose to sign purchase documents online, your electronic signature is legally binding, just like signing on paper. You can ask for paper copies instead. The agreements you sign, not this website, control the terms of your purchase.
AI chat and appointments

Our AI chat assistant can make mistakes and does not give legal, tax, or financial advice. Please confirm important details with a staff member. Requesting an appointment does not hold a home or guarantee it will be available. Contact us to confirm, change, or cancel a visit.
Using the website responsibly

Only provide information that is accurate and that you have the right to share. Do not send sensitive financial or identity information through general forms or chat. Do not misuse the website, try to access it without permission, upload harmful content, or interfere with other visitors.
Staff accounts
Staff tools are only for authorized Texas Home Outlet team members. Do not share sign-in links, codes, or PINs, and do not try to access staff areas without permission.
Website content and other websites

Text, photos, logos, and other materials on this website belong to us or to the companies that provided them. You may use the website for your own home shopping, but you may not copy materials for commercial use without permission. Other websites and services linked from this site have their own terms, and we are not responsible for their content.
Website availability and limits

We work to keep the website helpful and accurate, but we cannot promise it will always be available or free of errors. To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for losses caused by website errors or outages. Nothing in these terms removes rights or protections that cannot be waived under the law.
Privacy
Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle information from lead forms, chat, appointments, staff sign-in, analytics, and electronic signing.
Changes and questions

We may update these terms from time to time and will post the new version here with a new effective date. Questions? Contact Prosperity Acquisitions, Inc. dba Texas Home Outlet at sales@texashomeoutlet.com or (281) 324-3020.
